result.instructions: Tools for Loop Returns, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which returns were opened in the last 24 hours, and which are still open?"; "Show the details and notes for return 4821."; "Is order #1001 still eligible for a return?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Loop Returns data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run loopreturns_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run loopreturns_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run loopreturns_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. loopreturns_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_returns
tools.title: List returns
tools.description: List returns created or updated in a time range, with state, items and totals. Defaults to the last 24 hours and to open, closed and expired returns. Loop API: GET /warehouse/return/list.

from.description: Start of the range, ISO 8601 date or date-time. Max 120 days between from and to.

to.description: End of the range, ISO 8601 date or date-time.

filter.description: Date field the range applies to (default created_at).

paginate.description: Enable cursor pagination. The response then wraps returns with nextPageUrl.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous paginated response (nextPageUrl or cursor).

tools.name: loopreturns_get_return
tools.title: Get return details
tools.description: Get one return with its items, reasons, outcomes and money fields. Pass return_id, order_id or order_name (at least one). Loop API: GET /warehouse/return/details.

order_id.description: Commerce order id (for example the Shopify order id).

order_name.description: Order name from the commerce platform, for example #1001.

currency_type.description: Currency for money fields: shop or presentment.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_return_notes
tools.title: List return notes
tools.description: List the internal notes on one return. Loop API: GET /warehouse/return/{id}/notes.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_shipping_notices
tools.title: List advanced shipping notices
tools.description: List return packages with their tracking status in a date range (advanced shipping notice data). Loop API: GET /warehouse/reporting/asn.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_orders
tools.title: List orders
tools.description: List orders known to Loop, paginated. Loop API: GET /orders.

cursor.description: Cursor from a previous paginated response (nextPageUrl or cursor).

external_id.description: Filter by the commerce platform order id.

tools.name: loopreturns_get_order
tools.title: Get order
tools.description: Get the details of one order by its Loop id. Loop API: GET /orders/{id}.

tools.name: loopreturns_check_order_return_eligibility
tools.title: Check order return eligibility
tools.description: Report per-line-item return eligibility for an order by its order name, without starting a return. Loop API: POST /orders/return-eligibility.

order_name.description: Order name as the shop shows it, for example #1001.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_blocklist
tools.title: List blocklist entries
tools.description: List the blocklist entries that stop returns for a customer or value. Loop API: GET /blocklists.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_happy_returns_shipments
tools.title: List Happy Returns shipments
tools.description: List Happy Returns drop-off shipments created in a time range, paginated (200 per page). Loop API: GET /happy-returns/shipments.

from.description: Date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

to.description: Date and time in ISO 8601, for example 2026-11-01T00:00:00Z.

tools.name: loopreturns_list_destinations
tools.title: List return destinations
tools.description: List the return destinations (warehouses or addresses) set up in Loop. Loop API: GET /destinations.

tools.name: loopreturns_add_return_note
tools.title: Add a note to a return
tools.description: WRITE: post a new internal note (max 255 characters) on a return. Staff in Loop see it. Loop API: POST /warehouse/return/{id}/note.

annotations.title: Add a note to a return

tools.name: loopreturns_flag_return
tools.title: Flag a return for review
tools.description: WRITE: flag a return for human review. Loop then stops automated processing until a merchant reviews it in Loop Admin. Loop API: POST /warehouse/return/{id}/flag.
